white.description: Pure white, referenced by the tint half of every colour scale.

black.description: Pure black, referenced by the shade half of every colour scale.

space.description: The interpolation space every generated colour step is mixed in.

tint-color.description: What tints are mixed towards — the light end of every scale.

shade-color.description: What shades are mixed towards — the dark end of every scale.

base.description: The base spacer. Every step of the spacing scale is a multiple of it, so changing it rescales the whole system.

root.description: Upstream hardcodes this rather than deriving it from $spacer, so changing the base spacer does not move it.

base.description: The base radius. Every step of the 0–9 scale is a multiple of it, so one change rounds or squares every component at once.

pill.description: A fixed 50rem, set on $root-tokens after the $radii loop.

columns.description: How many columns a row divides into. Every `.col-*` class is generated from it, so this is a wider change than it looks.

row-columns.description: The highest count a `.row-cols-*` layout offers before you have to write your own.

gutter-x.description: Horizontal gutter between grid columns. It also sets the default container padding, so it decides the page margin too.

gutter-y.description: Vertical gutter between grid rows. Zero by default, so rows sit flush together unless you opt in.

container-padding-x.description: Inline padding inside a container, holding content clear of the viewport edge on small screens.

width.description: The default border width. Components reference it rather than hard-coding 1px.

style.description: The default border style. Every component reads it, so switching to `dashed` restyles the whole system rather than one element.

bg.description: A border the colour of the page — used to punch a gap between adjacent filled elements.

body.description: The standard visible border. Stronger than `subtle`, calmer than `emphasized`.

muted.description: A quieter border for grouping without drawing a line the eye stops at.

subtle.description: The faintest border. For separating areas that are already distinguished by space.

emphasized.description: A deliberately visible border, for focus targets and selected states.

white.description: Fixed white in both schemes, for an edge that must stay light whatever the theme does.

black.description: Fixed black in both schemes, for an edge that must stay dark whatever the theme does.

width-keyline.description: A sub-pixel hairline for dividers that should read as a seam rather than a border.

color.description: The default border colour, for anything that does not choose a more specific one.

color-translucent.description: A border mixed from the foreground rather than a fixed grey, so it works over any surface underneath.

checked-bg.description: Fill of a checkbox, radio or switch once it is on.

checked-border-color.description: Border of a checked control. Follows the checked fill unless you separate them.

active-bg.description: Fill of a control while it is being pressed.

active-border-color.description: Border of a control while it is being pressed. Follows the active fill unless you set the two apart.

disabled-bg.description: Fill of a control that cannot be used. Combined with the disabled opacity below, so the two compound.

disabled-opacity.description: How far a disabled control fades. Applied on top of the disabled fill, so both compound.

transition-duration.description: How long a checkbox or radio mark takes to appear.

transition-timing.description: Easing for a checkbox or radio mark. Overshoots slightly, so the mark pops rather than slides.

fg.description: Text colour shared by buttons and form fields, so an unstyled button matches an input beside it.

bg.description: Background shared by buttons and form fields. Variants paint over it; this is what an unstyled control shows.

gap.description: Space between a control’s icon and its label.

min-height.description: Minimum height of a button or form field. This is what sets the vertical rhythm of a form.

padding-y.description: Vertical padding inside a button or form field.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside a button or form field.

font-size.description: Text size inside a button or form field.

line-height.description: Leading inside a button or form field. Together with the padding it decides how tall the control ends up.

border-radius.description: Corner rounding on a button or form field. Taken from the radius scale, so it moves when the base radius does.

gap.description: Space between a control’s icon and its label at the extra-small size.

min-height.description: Minimum height of a button or form field at the extra-small size. This is what sets the vertical rhythm of a form.

padding-y.description: Vertical padding inside a button or form field at the extra-small size.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside a button or form field at the extra-small size.

font-size.description: Text size inside a button or form field at the extra-small size.

line-height.description: Leading inside a button or form field at the extra-small size. Together with the padding it decides how tall the control ends up.

border-radius.description: Corner rounding on a button or form field at the extra-small size. Taken from the radius scale, so it moves when the base radius does.

gap.description: Space between a control’s icon and its label at the small size.

min-height.description: Minimum height of a button or form field at the small size. This is what sets the vertical rhythm of a form.

padding-y.description: Vertical padding inside a button or form field at the small size.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside a button or form field at the small size.

font-size.description: Text size inside a button or form field at the small size.

line-height.description: Leading inside a button or form field at the small size. Together with the padding it decides how tall the control ends up.

border-radius.description: Corner rounding on a button or form field at the small size. Taken from the radius scale, so it moves when the base radius does.

gap.description: Space between a control’s icon and its label at the large size.

min-height.description: Minimum height of a button or form field at the large size. This is what sets the vertical rhythm of a form.

gradient.description: The sheen laid over filled components when `$enable-gradients` is on.

inset.description: An inward shadow, for wells and pressed states.

color.description: The colour every shadow is tinted from. Set it to a hue and the whole elevation scale warms or cools with it.

strength.description: Multiplies every shadow layer’s alpha. Dark mode is pinned to 2.4 by scss/_root.scss and no token map can reach it; a page with an explicit data-bs-theme needs a CSS rule as well as the Sass override. See docs/BACKLOG.md U4.

width.description: Thickness of the focus ring. Do not go below 2px: this is the only cue a keyboard user gets.

offset.description: Gap between a control and its focus ring, so the ring stays legible against the control.

color.description: Colour of the focus ring. Follows the primary role by default.

ring.description: The whole focus ring shorthand, composed from the width and colour above.

timing-overlay.description: Shared easing for overlays — dialogs, drawers and menus — so they all enter with the same character.

1.description: The first raised surface — card headers, table stripes, anything a step above the page.

2.description: A second step up, for a surface raised above one that is already raised.

3.description: A third step, used mostly for disabled controls and inset wells.

4.description: The strongest neutral fill before you reach an inverted surface.

body.description: The page background. Every other surface is measured against it.

fg.description: The foreground colour used as a background — for inverted blocks that flip the page around.

white.description: Fixed white in both schemes. Use it when a surface must not follow the theme.

black.description: Fixed black in both schemes. Use it when a surface must not follow the theme.

transparent.description: No background at all. Use it to clear an inherited one.

1.description: Slightly de-emphasised text — secondary lines that still have to be read comfortably.

2.description: Supporting text: captions, helper text under a field, table metadata.

3.description: Faint text for labels and placeholders. Below WCAG AA for body copy, so keep it off long prose.

4.description: The faintest step, for decorative or disabled text only. It does not meet WCAG AA at any size.

white.description: Pure white, referenced by the tint half of every colour scale.

black.description: Pure black, referenced by the shade half of every colour scale.

space.description: The interpolation space every generated colour step is mixed in.

tint-color.description: What tints are mixed towards — the light end of every scale.

shade-color.description: What shades are mixed towards — the dark end of every scale.

base.description: The base spacer. Every step of the spacing scale is a multiple of it, so changing it rescales the whole system.

root.description: Upstream hardcodes this rather than deriving it from $spacer, so changing the base spacer does not move it.

base.description: The base radius. Every step of the 0–9 scale is a multiple of it, so one change rounds or squares every component at once.

pill.description: A fixed 50rem, set on $root-tokens after the $radii loop.

columns.description: How many columns a row divides into. Every `.col-*` class is generated from it, so this is a wider change than it looks.

row-columns.description: The highest count a `.row-cols-*` layout offers before you have to write your own.

gutter-x.description: Horizontal gutter between grid columns. It also sets the default container padding, so it decides the page margin too.

gutter-y.description: Vertical gutter between grid rows. Zero by default, so rows sit flush together unless you opt in.

container-padding-x.description: Inline padding inside a container, holding content clear of the viewport edge on small screens.

width.description: The default border width. Components reference it rather than hard-coding 1px.

style.description: The default border style. Every component reads it, so switching to `dashed` restyles the whole system rather than one element.

bg.description: A border the colour of the page — used to punch a gap between adjacent filled elements.

body.description: The standard visible border. Stronger than `subtle`, calmer than `emphasized`.

muted.description: A quieter border for grouping without drawing a line the eye stops at.

subtle.description: The faintest border. For separating areas that are already distinguished by space.

emphasized.description: A deliberately visible border, for focus targets and selected states.

white.description: Fixed white in both schemes, for an edge that must stay light whatever the theme does.

black.description: Fixed black in both schemes, for an edge that must stay dark whatever the theme does.

width-keyline.description: A sub-pixel hairline for dividers that should read as a seam rather than a border.

color.description: The default border colour, for anything that does not choose a more specific one.

color-translucent.description: A border mixed from the foreground rather than a fixed grey, so it works over any surface underneath.

checked-bg.description: Fill of a checkbox, radio or switch once it is on.

checked-border-color.description: Border of a checked control. Follows the checked fill unless you separate them.

active-bg.description: Fill of a control while it is being pressed.

active-border-color.description: Border of a control while it is being pressed. Follows the active fill unless you set the two apart.

disabled-bg.description: Fill of a control that cannot be used. Combined with the disabled opacity below, so the two compound.

disabled-opacity.description: How far a disabled control fades. Applied on top of the disabled fill, so both compound.

transition-duration.description: How long a checkbox or radio mark takes to appear.

transition-timing.description: Easing for a checkbox or radio mark. Overshoots slightly, so the mark pops rather than slides.

fg.description: Text colour shared by buttons and form fields, so an unstyled button matches an input beside it.

bg.description: Background shared by buttons and form fields. Variants paint over it; this is what an unstyled control shows.

gap.description: Space between a control’s icon and its label.

min-height.description: Minimum height of a button or form field. This is what sets the vertical rhythm of a form.

padding-y.description: Vertical padding inside a button or form field.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside a button or form field.

font-size.description: Text size inside a button or form field.

line-height.description: Leading inside a button or form field. Together with the padding it decides how tall the control ends up.

border-radius.description: Corner rounding on a button or form field. Taken from the radius scale, so it moves when the base radius does.

gap.description: Space between a control’s icon and its label at the extra-small size.

min-height.description: Minimum height of a button or form field at the extra-small size. This is what sets the vertical rhythm of a form.

padding-y.description: Vertical padding inside a button or form field at the extra-small size.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside a button or form field at the extra-small size.

font-size.description: Text size inside a button or form field at the extra-small size.

line-height.description: Leading inside a button or form field at the extra-small size. Together with the padding it decides how tall the control ends up.

border-radius.description: Corner rounding on a button or form field at the extra-small size. Taken from the radius scale, so it moves when the base radius does.

gap.description: Space between a control’s icon and its label at the small size.

min-height.description: Minimum height of a button or form field at the small size. This is what sets the vertical rhythm of a form.

padding-y.description: Vertical padding inside a button or form field at the small size.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside a button or form field at the small size.

font-size.description: Text size inside a button or form field at the small size.

line-height.description: Leading inside a button or form field at the small size. Together with the padding it decides how tall the control ends up.

border-radius.description: Corner rounding on a button or form field at the small size. Taken from the radius scale, so it moves when the base radius does.

gap.description: Space between a control’s icon and its label at the large size.

min-height.description: Minimum height of a button or form field at the large size. This is what sets the vertical rhythm of a form.

padding-y.description: Vertical padding inside a button or form field at the large size.

padding-x.description: Horizontal padding inside a button or form field at the large size.

font-size.description: Text size inside a button or form field at the large size.

line-height.description: Leading inside a button or form field at the large size. Together with the padding it decides how tall the control ends up.

border-radius.description: Corner rounding on a button or form field at the large size. Taken from the radius scale, so it moves when the base radius does.

gradient.description: The sheen laid over filled components when `$enable-gradients` is on.

inset.description: An inward shadow, for wells and pressed states.

color.description: The colour every shadow is tinted from. Set it to a hue and the whole elevation scale warms or cools with it.

strength.description: Multiplies every shadow layer’s alpha. Dark mode is pinned to 2.4 by scss/_root.scss and no token map can reach it; a page with an explicit data-bs-theme needs a CSS rule as well as the Sass override. See docs/BACKLOG.md U4.

width.description: Thickness of the focus ring. Do not go below 2px: this is the only cue a keyboard user gets.

offset.description: Gap between a control and its focus ring, so the ring stays legible against the control.

color.description: Colour of the focus ring. Follows the primary role by default.

ring.description: The whole focus ring shorthand, composed from the width and colour above.

timing-overlay.description: Shared easing for overlays — dialogs, drawers and menus — so they all enter with the same character.

1.description: The first raised surface — card headers, table stripes, anything a step above the page.

2.description: A second step up, for a surface raised above one that is already raised.

3.description: A third step, used mostly for disabled controls and inset wells.

4.description: The strongest neutral fill before you reach an inverted surface.

body.description: The page background. Every other surface is measured against it.

fg.description: The foreground colour used as a background — for inverted blocks that flip the page around.

white.description: Fixed white in both schemes. Use it when a surface must not follow the theme.

black.description: Fixed black in both schemes. Use it when a surface must not follow the theme.

transparent.description: No background at all. Use it to clear an inherited one.

1.description: Slightly de-emphasised text — secondary lines that still have to be read comfortably.

2.description: Supporting text: captions, helper text under a field, table metadata.

3.description: Faint text for labels and placeholders. Below WCAG AA for body copy, so keep it off long prose.

4.description: The faintest step, for decorative or disabled text only. It does not meet WCAG AA at any size.

font-family.description: The body font stack. It deliberately omits `system-ui`, which resolves to the locale’s UI font and renders non-Latin text incorrectly.

font-size.description: Base text size. Component sizes that reference it follow; the fluid heading scale does not.

font-weight.description: Weight of ordinary running text. Headings set their own, so this governs paragraphs and labels.

line-height.description: Leading for running text. Headings override it, so this mostly decides how dense a paragraph feels.

border-color.description: Colour of a horizontal rule, and of the divider inside an alert or a card.

color.description: Link colour. Uses the solid brand colour in light mode and the lighter text variant in dark.

decoration.description: How a link is marked. Removing the underline leaves colour as the only cue, which fails for readers who cannot distinguish it.

underline-offset.description: How far the underline sits below the text. Enough clearance keeps it from cutting through descenders.

hover-color.description: Link colour on hover — the base colour darkened, so the shift reads without changing hue.

font-size.description: Code size relative to its surrounding text, so inline code does not tower over the line.

color.description: Colour of inline code, set a step away from running text so it reads as a quotation.
